(Kristin Murphy | Pool) Gov. Spencer Cox speaks at a monthly news conference in Salt Lake City on Thursday, April 30, 2026.

Comment

Add as Preferred Source

Can anyone explain to me Gov. Cox‘s proclamation about family and faith and fidelity and stuff? I mean, the governor is a supporter — sometimes strong, sometimes weak, but nonetheless a supporter — of our current president.

That would be the same president who had an affair with his second wife while still married to his first, has made no secret about his inappropriate attraction to his own daughter, and consorted with a prostitute while his third wife was pregnant with their son, etc. Need I go on? Where’s the fidelity?

It does make me wonder if our governor is angling for a permanent placement on the federal government payroll, presumably as a judge. If so, the grateful taxpayer (that’s you and me) will be supporting him for the rest of his career, disagreeing better all the time.

Patrick de Freitas, Salt Lake City
